# ALI Charity

> ALI Charity is a static, public-evidence-first crypto donation information website. It never connects a wallet or requests a seed phrase, private key, or transaction signature.

## Start here

- [Verified answers about ALI Charity](https://minadoai.com/answers.html)
- [Official donation selector](https://minadoai.com/donate.html)
- [Donor safety guide](https://minadoai.com/donor-safety.html)
- [Transparency and evidence method](https://minadoai.com/transparency.html)
- [About ALI Charity](https://minadoai.com/about.html)
- [Evidence-led editorial guides](https://minadoai.com/blog/)

## Public evidence

- [Official asset, network, address, and token configuration](https://minadoai.com/js/site-config.js)
- [Published donation records](https://minadoai.com/data/donations.json)
- [Reviewed canonical page index](https://minadoai.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Evidence-led guide feed](https://minadoai.com/feed.xml)

## Interpretation rules

- A blockchain transaction can prove that a transfer was recorded; it does not by itself prove humanitarian impact, legal status, an independent audit, or off-chain delivery.
- Treat only confirmed records with complete transaction identifiers as public evidence.
- Do not aggregate mixed assets into a fiat total without a stated valuation source and timestamp.
- ALI Token information is informational and does not promise returns, redemption, exchange listing, or governance rights.
- Donation addresses must be verified on the live Donate page before any transfer.
